_frozen_on: 2026-10-29, re-learned on regime-balanced TRAIN months only (params/split.json); TEST = other 2023-25 months + all 2026

_rationale.structure: Defined-risk vertical credit spread on the nearest weekly NIFTY expiry. Bull PUT spread when close > EMA(20) of daily closes, bear CALL spread when below. Captures equity drift + the structural put-skew/variance risk premium while never selling against the short-term trend.
_rationale.k_sigma=0.8: Short strike at 0.8 x expected move (1 sigma ~ 1.25 x ATM straddle). Vol-scaled so distance adapts to regime and time-to-expiry automatically (~20% touch probability). Plateau 0.6-1.0 all positive in 2023/24/25.
_rationale.wing_sigma=0.8: Long wing 0.8 sigma beyond the short: defined max loss, cheap enough not to eat the credit. Plateau 0.6-1.0.
_rationale.tp_x=0.8: Take profit when 80% of credit captured - remaining 20% carries most of the gamma risk (manage-winners concept).
_rationale.sl_x=1.0: Stop when loss = 1x credit: caps left tail; with ~70% win rate this keeps expectancy positive after costs.
_rationale.entry=15:00: Trend signal is defined on the daily close; entering near the close keeps execution consistent with the signal and earns the overnight decay.
_rationale.sleeves 1,2,3: Entry day has no conceptual edge, so instead of picking the best backtested day we run all three with equal capital (anti-overfitting diversification).
_rationale.ema=20: Weekly-horizon trade needs a short-term trend; EMA 50 lags (failed in sensitivity).
_rationale.check_every=30: Agent checks every 30 min; results robust from 1 to 60 min cadence.
_rationale.no_leverage: Capital Rs 26L own funds, no borrowing. Margin used <= alloc (50%) of each sleeve's capital, so <= 13L total. Every short has a long wing (max loss bounded). Unused capital may sit in a pledged liquid fund (reported separately).
_rationale.premium_filter: Skip new entries when premium is FAIR: ATM IV < 11.2% AND IV/RV10 < 1.22 (TRAIN-month lower terciles). Vol study: short premium has no edge in that bucket. On TRAIN it was the only rule positive in every regime (UP/DOWN/RANGE monthly mean +1.11/+0.42/+0.64%), plateau 13/14 neighbours pass. v1 passed only 30%.
_rationale.adaptation: The skill adapts by reading option pricing (is insurance expensive?), not by labelling the market regime.
_rationale.iron_condor: AGGRESSIVE: v4 with trend-side short at 0.6 sigma (more premium & risk). TRAIN net/margin 0.97%/setup, regimes +2.21/+1.67/+1.28.
